blind_spots.blind_spot: Conduit Platform is marketed as 'Cloud Agnostic Deployment' with 'Reduced Infra Costs' by eliminating on-prem hardware, while the SBIR work is explicitly for JADC2 and DAF space domain awareness.
blind_spots.operator_reality: JADC2 data has to run at IL4/IL5 or on disconnected tactical edge nodes — a pitch built around eliminating hardware and living in the cloud is the opposite of what a Space Force ground terminal or contested-comms sensor feed needs.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The commercial-facing site was written for enterprise SaaS buyers (Hotels Network testimonial), not for the DAF/Space Force audience the SBIRs target.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Cloud Agnostic Deployment...without the event streaming platform maintenance

blind_spots.blind_spot: 'Real-Time Data Streaming: Say goodbye to batch delays' is the core value prop, with no mention of a batch/resync fallback mode.
blind_spots.operator_reality: This is the canonical 30fps-crowd-detection failure mode restated for data pipelines — a sensor feed integrating 'US and Allied Partner Sensor Data' (their own SBIR title) into the Unified Data Library will hit exactly the bandwidth-denial conditions that break a real-time-only architecture.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Product was built and marketed as a generic real-time streaming tool first, defense funding came later as a use case, not an architecture constraint.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Say goodbye to batch delays. Welcome instant insights and real-time analytics into your decision-making process

blind_spots.blind_spot: The SBIR abstract title is literally 'Real-Time Data Transformation to Accelerate Integration of US and Allied Partner Sensor Data' — cross-national sensor data — yet the commercial site never mentions ITAR, export control, or data classification handling anywhere.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Allied-partner sensor data integration is a textbook ITAR/foreign-disclosure minefield; a company that pitches '100+ pre-built connectors' and 'connect anything anywhere' without a word on controlled-data handling is building the plumbing before the compliance gate, which is exactly what kills a Phase II-to-Phase III transition.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team appears focused on connector breadth and commercial GTM rather than government compliance posture.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Real-Time Data Transformation to Accelerate Integration of US and Allied Partner Sensor Data into the Unified Data Library

opener_hook: Meroxa's three 2022 AF SBIR Phase IIs (JADC2 test data, DAF space domain awareness, multi-domain ops) and the $1.25M Space Systems Command award are public — the commercial site built from that work has no ATO or IL5 language anywhere.
what_they_do: Sells Conduit, a low-code real-time data streaming/integration platform, commercially — funded in part by three 2022 Air Force SBIR Phase IIs for JADC2 and space domain awareness data pipelines.
